## Summary

Vertex AI Research is an independent AI safety and capabilities research group focused on
building reliable, interpretable, and aligned large-scale language and reasoning models. We
are a synthetic JD fixture used to test the resume pipeline against the direct-portal shape.
Do not treat as a real role.

We are looking for an AI Research Engineer to work at the boundary between research and
engineering. This is not a pure research role and not a pure engineering role. You will be
expected to implement ideas from the research literature, run systematic experiments, author
internal technical reports, and collaborate directly with staff researchers on projects that
push the frontier. We expect you to write excellent code and to have genuine opinions about
model design.

## Responsibilities

- Implement and evaluate novel model architectures and training recipes from research prototypes
  to reproducible experimental baselines
- Design evaluation harnesses and benchmarking pipelines that measure alignment, reasoning, and
  robustness properties rigorously
- Run large-scale training experiments on TPU and GPU clusters and analyze results quantitatively
- Co-author internal technical reports and external preprints with research staff
- Build and maintain shared research infrastructure including training frameworks, evaluation
  tooling, and experiment tracking systems
- Stay current with the research literature and synthesize findings into actionable insights for
  the team

## Required Skills

- 4+ years of combined research and engineering experience with first-author or significant
  contribution publications at a top-tier ML venue
- Expert-level PyTorch including custom autograd, mixed precision, FSDP, and inference optimization
- Solid JAX proficiency including functional transforms, vmap, pmap, and XLA compilation patterns
- Deep understanding of transformer architectures including attention variants, normalization
  strategies, positional encodings, and scaling behavior
- Experience running and debugging large-scale distributed training jobs including fault tolerance
  and checkpoint management
- Strong statistical reasoning skills for experimental design, significance testing, and
  communicating uncertainty in results
- Ability to read and critically evaluate ML research papers and reproduce results reliably
- Excellent technical writing skills for communicating complex findings to internal and external
  audiences

## Preferred

- Publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, or comparable venues as first or second author
- Experience with alignment-relevant research areas such as RLHF, RLAIF, constitutional AI,
  mechanistic interpretability, or formal verification of neural systems
- Background in scaling laws experiments or infrastructure for large pre-training runs
- Familiarity with TPU programming and XLA profiling for identifying bottlenecks in training
- Experience building evaluation suites for reasoning, factuality, and instruction-following
  at scale beyond standard benchmarks

## Compensation

$200,000 – $280,000 base salary + RSU grant + research budget + benefits

RSU grant vests over four years with a one-year cliff. We provide a personal compute budget
for exploratory research, access to internal GPU and TPU clusters, conference travel and
registration fees, open-source time allocation, and full medical, dental, and vision coverage.

Candidates based in the EU receive equivalent compensation adjusted for local purchasing power
and statutory benefits in their country of residence. We sponsor work authorization for
exceptional candidates.

## About Vertex AI Research

Vertex AI Research was founded with the belief that safe and capable AI are complementary
goals, not competing ones. Our team publishes openly, collaborates with the academic community,
and builds tools that benefit the broader research ecosystem as well as our own work.

We operate on a small-team model where every researcher and engineer has significant autonomy
and direct ownership over their research agenda. We do not have managers in the traditional
sense. We have project leads who are accountable for outcomes but do not direct day-to-day
work. If you thrive in an environment of intellectual freedom with high accountability, you
will fit well here.

We are a distributed team with hubs in the US and EU and a strong culture of async collaboration
combined with regular in-person research retreats. The role is fully remote with an expectation
of attending two to three week-long research sprints per year.

Vertex AI Research is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and
inclusion in the research community.
